title: Courtesy Rate per Month on Refunded Second Charges — Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
The courtesy rate per month on a refunded second Kestrel Rx Savings Club fee charge of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs is set by the fee charges standing on the membership, counted as every fee charge booked less every fee charge refunded.

| Standing fee charges on the membership | Courtesy rate per month |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | $0.30 |
| exactly 3 | $0.28 |
| 2 or fewer | $0.25 |

Every fee charge on the membership's fee history is counted, and each fee refund on it is taken off.

**Hypothetical fee histories.**

- 5 charges booked, 1 refunded: 4 standing, $0.30 a month.
- 4 charges booked, 1 refunded: 3 standing, $0.28 a month.
- 3 charges booked, 1 refunded: 2 standing, $0.25 a month.
